summary: The old harness can reach basic spoiler rendering by supplying MD_FLAG_SPOILERS in its flag prefix and spoiler text as the payload. Its eight-byte prefix also permits short Markdown payloads. Full coverage remains unverified because the supplied evidence omits the block-processing path into inline parsing.

claims.necessity_reason: The old harness accepts arbitrary parser flags and passes the remaining bytes to md_html, so a finite input can select MD_FLAG_SPOILERS and supply ||text||.

before.reason: The complete before span enumeration and HTML span callbacks have no spoiler span contract.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS, parse ||text|| as a spoiler span and emit opening and closing x-spoiler tags.
after.reason: The flag is an unsigned bitmask value that the harness can place in its first unsigned word. The remaining bytes can contain ||text||; the parser resolves double-pipe marks and the renderer emits both tags.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Collects a double pipe as one mark when the spoiler flag is set.
Passes unresolved double-pipe marks to the spoiler resolver.
Turns resolved double-pipe marks into spoiler span callbacks.

claims.comparison_reason: This spoiler contract is added after the change, and the fixed old harness already provides a route to it.

claims.necessity_reason: The size guard excludes short total fuzz inputs, but an eight-byte flag prefix followed by a short Markdown document is an equivalent route on both sides.

before.requirement: Invoke md_html with a Markdown payload shorter than eight bytes.
before.reason: md_html accepts an explicit input size. An input with the eight-byte prefix and a short or empty remainder passes the harness guard and invokes it with that remainder.

after.requirement: Invoke md_html with a Markdown payload shorter than eight bytes.
after.reason: The same explicit-size contract and the same eight-byte-prefix route remain available.

claims.comparison_reason: The apparent preexisting size constraint applies to the whole fuzz input, not the Markdown payload passed to md_html.

missing_information: The before and after bodies of src/md4c.c::md_process_all_blocks and its callees that dispatch paragraph and table-cell content to md_analyze_inlines and md_process_inlines are needed to complete target control-flow coverage.
The before and after MD_CHAR definition in src/md4c.h is needed to complete input-format coverage under the supplied build configuration.
